Coding

Description

Plugin can be used to edit and debug codes and release Mini Program applications, improving coding efficiency.

  • Real-time preview
  • MAML autocomplete
  • API autocomplete and syntax prompt

Project Creation

  1. Click the New Project menu in the tool directory of the plug-in sidebar, and the create project page will pop up on the right.
  2. Fill in the project name and select the project location
  3. Select Project Template, the default is to create a Hello World project (minimum version: 24.12.0)
  4. Click the New button to create a new project
  5. In the message box, select how to open the new project

MAML Autocomplete

MAML auto-completion helps complete pairs of MAML tags when writing MAML files, reducing coding oversight and orchestration errors. For example, after you enter <view>, the developer tool automatically supplements </view> paired with </view>.

API Autocomplete and Syntax Prompt

As you enter code, the developer tool displays possible APIs and associated syntax hints in real time.

Page and Component Creation

Right-click in the file tree and choose New Page or Component from the shortcut menu.

Real-time Preview

This function can achieve the real-time and quick preview of the simulator effect when writing Mini Programs. After you edit and modify the maml, mass, js, and json files and save the file, the simulator previews the compilation status in real time.
